attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual inspection in the bulk-creation of inspections.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The user-provided name of the inspections.

attributes.name: URL
attributes.description: The URL link to an external page hosted by the partner with additional details about the inspection.

attributes.name: InspectionDate
attributes.description: The date the inspection was conducted. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2025-03-25". If not provided, defaults to the current date.

attributes.name: OccupancyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy related to the inspection. Only one of OccupancyId, PropertyId, or UnitId may be specified.

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property related to the inspection. Only one of OccupancyId, PropertyId, or UnitId may be specified.

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit related to the inspection. Only one of OccupancyId, PropertyId, or UnitId may be specified.

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier for the bulk creation job
